working_tree: Dirty before and after; no commit created. Existing unrelated changes preserved.

changes.test_registration: workloads.cmake registers graph_p8_workload_timing alongside the unchanged graph_p8_workloads command.

design_comparison.selected: Standalone evaluator over existing complete traces; one explicit budget_us parameter; ordinary Python records/functions.
design_comparison.new_guest_clock: Rejected for this slice: Q19 explicitly says no new guest API; adding a clock would require runtime/port semantics and still would not prove cross-device acquisition age.
design_comparison.relative_event_wait: Cannot establish periodic acquisition or elapsed periods because wakeups may return early and processing adds drift.
design_comparison.external_pacing: Requires additional peripheral/source plumbing; larger than this measurement increment.
design_comparison.alternative_channels: APP03 is an independent conforming next slice, retained as next implementation work.
design_comparison.embedded_guidance: No classes/polymorphism framework, new embedded allocation, resource bound or guest ABI introduced. Generic refactoring heuristics did not justify these additions.

semantics.clock: Common POSIX host monotonic microseconds from CHANNEL records. Reader-thread arrival order is not event order. Not applicable to unrelated physical clocks.
semantics.origin: First successful source10 PUT over the complete trace, keyed by concrete source instance and 32-bit sequence. Retries do not reset origin; short fixtures must not wrap sequence.
semantics.correlation: Validate values/padding and phase identities using existing evaluate(); require source PUT <= expected transform/responder GET <= its PUT <= final GET. Reject missing or impossible earliest copy history.
semantics.cohort: First origin in [begin,end) and origin + budget_us < end. Uniformly exclude/count tail publications even if already delivered; prewindow publications cannot enter by retrying.
semantics.pass: At least one eligible publication in every phase; each has an in-window first final GET with elapsed <= budget_us.
semantics.miss: Late final GET or no final GET by window end. Does not diagnose cause or count scheduled acquisition misses. GETs outside the window do not change its outcome.
semantics.inconclusive: Incomplete channel trace; or no eligible publications in a phase, unless another complete phase already demonstrates a budget failure.
semantics.statistics: Min/max elapsed include delivered eligible publications only; missing publications contribute no elapsed value.
semantics.separation: Timing status and original sample_status are distinct; original reports/result.json are never overwritten. Timing pass does not imply eight-sample throughput or protocol success.
semantics.cli: python -m sim_env.graph_workload_timing RUN --budget-us N [--output NEW_FILE]. Exclusive-create output. Exit 0 timing pass; 1 failed/inconclusive; 2 input/output validation error.

checks.sanitizers: ASan and fail-fast UBSan. Existing WAMR checks disable fake stacks; no new target timing claim.

existing_sources.scope: All C/H/Python tests and fixtures in verification and sibling tests before this increment.

replay.original_graph_operations: All eight succeeded; no remaining instances reported.

new_test_coverage: Exact budget equality; late and unobserved samples; full denominator accounting.
First origin survives retries and duplicate final GETs count once.
Prewindow retry exclusion; deadline equality at exclusive window end; early-delivered tail remains excluded.
Empty cohort and incomplete trace cannot pass.
Missing or future source origin rejected; replacement cannot borrow old transform evidence.
Impossible transform PUT/GET order and missing intermediate GET rejected.
Positive integer budget and per-host monotonic timestamp validation.
Cross-host reader order does not override timestamps; timing and sample-count statuses remain separate.
Two CLI evaluations produce identical reports; input/evaluator hashes recorded; original result unchanged; overwrite refused.
Real delayed pipeline has successful graph operations but misses synthetic budget; all nodes explicitly removed.
Real local feedback yields correlated elapsed observations with no relay data packets.

review.method: Two independent design comparisons followed by read-only implementation reviews; supplied plan and AGENTS.md are the relevant spec/standards.
review.found_and_fixed: Draft checked source and transform PUT independently against final GET, allowing impossible ordering. Added ordered copy-boundary check and regression with three invalid histories; regression failed before fix and passed after.
review.replay_gap_fixed: Added second completed CLI evaluation and byte-equivalent JSON comparison rather than only checking overwrite refusal.
review.disposition: Reviewer confirmed attribution fix; no remaining substantive findings. Reviews were scoped to the new slice, not all pre-existing dirty changes.

environment_notes: Initial staged process tests were blocked by sandbox UDP permissions; rerun with approval passed. Full suites used approved UDP/subprocess/LeakSanitizer access.
New sibling files were staged, reviewed and tested before approved exclusive-create installation; no existing sibling file overwritten.

results/p8_timing/retained-pipeline-timing.json is an exploratory replay before the causal-order review fix. pipeline-timing.json is the final installed evaluator result; its evaluator hashes identify the corrected implementation.
remaining: APP01 periodic acquisition, scheduled-miss counting and acquisition freshness remain open; no mandatory guest time API or field added.
OBS09 clock offset/drift qualification remains open. Replay determinism does not establish deterministic host reruns under different schedules.
Alternative-channel APP03/APP04 fixtures, named lifecycle fault barriers, broader observation coverage and crash/freeze/collector cases remain P8 work.
R07/R08 ventilation policy, QoC, plant parameters and measurement qualification remain gated; physical target and composed formal P9 qualification remain open.
Best-effort delivery, trusted fixture computation, GET copy-out scope, tracing overhead and local pipeline response-cache teardown limits are unchanged.
